mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders(order_no, idempotent_key, user_id, plan_summary, travel_date, travelers, contact_name, contact_phone, remark, total_amount, status) VALUES(#{orderNo}, #{idempotentKey}, #{userId}, #{planSummary}, #{travelDate}, #{travelers}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{remark}, #{totalAmount}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = #{status} WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
UPDATE orders SET status = #{status}, contact_name = #{contactName}, contact_phone = #{contactPhone}, remark = #{remark} WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
